answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 35 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. Deposits are visible in orchard, and inlet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 24% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2491 identities would post 3797 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
